nodes.label: conventions (top-level complexType)
nodes.rationale: Root choice-of-unbounded container aggregating every named market convention type used across ORE curve/index/trade configuration.

nodes.label: Tenor Basis Swap Convention
nodes.rationale: Contains deprecated legacy fields (LongIndex/ShortIndex/SpreadOnShort) alongside current fields, reflecting schema evolution.

nodes.label: Commodity Future Convention
nodes.rationale: Most elaborate convention type in the file: anchor-day rules, continuation mappings, averaging data and off-peak power index data nested inline.

nodes.label: simmCalibration complexType
nodes.rationale: One versioned SIMM calibration (e.g. ISDA SIMM 2.x) identified by VersionNames and an id attribute; aggregates per-risk-class calibration blocks.

nodes.label: IR/FX Concentration Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Extends the generic concentrationThresholds complexType with an extra CurrencyLists element specific to IR and FX risk classes.

nodes.label: SensitivityAnalysis complexType
nodes.rationale: Top-level configuration for the ORE sensitivity analytic: enumerates every market-object family whose shift/bump definitions are to be generated, plus par-conversion and cross-gamma controls.

nodes.label: Recovery Rate Sensitivity
nodes.rationale: Defined in sensitivity.xsd but not consumed by SensitivityAnalysis itself; only stress.xsd's StressTest wraps it via the recoveryrates plural type.

nodes.label: Survival Probability Sensitivity
nodes.rationale: Defined in sensitivity.xsd but not consumed by SensitivityAnalysis itself; only stress.xsd's StressTest wraps it via the survivalprobabilities plural type.

nodes.label: TodaysMarket complexType
nodes.rationale: Defines the market data build plan: named, versioned sets of curves/vol surfaces plus named Configurations that select which set of each is used together.

nodes.label: referenceDataTypes choice group
nodes.rationale: Abstract xs:group listing the polymorphic ReferenceDatum payload types selectable per ReferenceDatum/Type value.

nodes.label: Generic Credit Reference Datum (lax any-content)
nodes.rationale: Uses xs:any processContents=lax, i.e. deliberately unstructured — the schema does not attempt to constrain CreditReferenceData content, a direct example of the coverage gap the caveat node describes.

nodes.label: Currency Hedged Equity Index Reference Datum
Portfolio Basket Reference Datum
nodes.rationale: Embeds a Components/Trade list that structurally mirrors the top-level Trade definition in input.xsd (TradeType/Envelope/oreTradeData group).

nodes.label: StressTest scenario
nodes.rationale: A single named stress scenario; reuses several plural wrapper types defined in sensitivity.xsd (FxSpots, SwaptionVolatilities, EquitySpots, EquityVolatilities, RecoveryRates, SurvivalProbabilities) rather than redefining them.

nodes.label: Stress Survival Probability Shift (unused type)
nodes.rationale: Defined (stresssurvivalprobability/stresssurvivalprobabilities) but StressTest's SurvivalProbabilities field actually points at sensitivity.xsd's survivalprobabilities type instead — this type looks orphaned/dead in the schema, a concrete instance of the imperfections flagged by the coverage caveat.

nodes.label: ore_script (payoff script) complexType
nodes.rationale: Holds ORE scripting-language Code/NPV/Results plus schedule-coarsening, calibration, sticky-close-out and AMC computation-graph overrides for the ScriptedTrade payoff framework.

nodes.label: CSADetails (CSA terms)
nodes.rationale: mixed=true complexType covering thresholds, MTAs, independent amount, margining frequency, eligible collateral currencies and initial/variation margin flags for a netting set's CSA.

nodes.label: CollateralBalances complexType (embedded copy)
nodes.rationale: An identical CollateralBalances definition also lives standalone in collateralbalance.xsd; input.xsd's include of collateralbalance.xsd is commented out, so in practice this embedded copy is the one that is actually wired into the master schema.

nodes.label: Master ORE Input Schema (input.xsd)
nodes.rationale: Aggregator schema: does not define much itself beyond Portfolio/Trade, but xs:includes nearly every other ORE XSD module to form the complete input document grammar.

nodes.label: Counterparty entry
nodes.rationale: Per-counterparty CVA/CCR attributes: clearing flag, credit quality, BA-CVA/SA-CCR risk weights, SA-CVA risk bucket.

nodes.label: Product engine/model config
nodes.rationale: Per instrument-type Model/Engine selection plus free-form name/value ModelParameters and EngineParameters lists.

nodes.label: ore top-level complexType (ORE run config)
nodes.rationale: Root of the modern ORE 'analytics' run configuration: Setup/Logging/Markets parameter lists plus an unbounded list of Analytic blocks (e.g. NPV, SENSITIVITY, XVA).

nodes.label: IBOR to RFR Fallback entry
nodes.rationale: Per-index fallback: target RFR index, spread adjustment and switch date, modeling IBOR cessation (e.g. LIBOR to SOFR/SONIA) transitions.

nodes.label: CollateralBalances complexType (standalone)
nodes.rationale: Per netting-set observed InitialMargin/VariationMargin balance; standalone file whose include in input.xsd is commented out (superseded by the copy embedded in nettingsetdefinitions.xsd).

nodes.label: XSD Schema Coverage Caveat
nodes.rationale: These XSD schema files are known to be incomplete/imperfect and do not perfectly represent every real-world ORE XML variation seen in production trade/config files. Treat schema-derived structure as a guide, not ground truth.

hyperedges.label: Netting Set / CSA / Collateral Balance Configuration Group
